svg.title: Loss on drying of stored cat food
svg.desc: Grouped bars compare plastic and aluminum foil containers at four silica gel amounts on Days 0, 14, and 21. Error bars show sample standard deviation for three containers per treatment and day.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Loss on drying of stored cat food
Mean +/- 1 sample SD | n = 3 containers per treatment and day
